NONE: › earned or obtained without having been worked for
不勞而獲的
› money that you get from investments and property that you own, instead of earning by working
（因投資、擁有房産等獲得的）非勞動所得
› to discover something in the ground
發掘，掘出，使出土
› to discover proof or some other information, especially after careful searching
（尤指在仔細搜尋之後）發現

example: Building at the site was halted after human remains were unearthed earlier this month.
自從本月初在工地挖出人類遺骸之後，施工就停止了。
A private detective has unearthed some fresh evidence.
一個私家偵探已經找到了新的證據。

NONE: › informal An unearthly time is not at all convenient because it is too early in the morning or too late at night.
（時間）非常不方便的，過早的，過晚的
› strange in a mysterious and sometimes frightening way
怪異的；異常的；恐怖的

example: I was woken up at some unearthly hour of the morning by someone knocking on my door.
我一大清早就被敲門聲吵醒了。
Cats' cries have an unearthly quality.
貓的叫聲令人毛骨悚然。

NONE: › worry or anxiety
焦慮，不安

example: Growing unease at the prospect of an election is causing fierce arguments within the party.
對選舉前景日益增長的擔憂情緒引起了黨內激烈的爭論。

NONE: B2 slightly worried or uncomfortable about a particular situation
不安的，焦慮的，擔心的
› used to describe a situation or condition that makes people slightly worried, often because it may not continue successfully
（局勢或情況）不穩定的，緊張的，令人不安的

example: I feel a little uneasy about asking her to do me such a big favour.
請她幫我這麽大的忙，我有點忐忑不安。
Who can predict how long this uneasy peace between the two countries will last?
誰能預言兩國之間勉強維持的和平能持續多久？
She has a slightly uneasy relationship with her mother-in-law.
她和婆婆的關係有一些緊張。

NONE: › Uneconomic businesses and industries are not making enough profit or are losing money.
（企業、産業）不景氣的，賺不到錢的，賠本的
› Uneconomic processes or activities use more of something than is necessary, causing it to be wasted.
（過程或活動）不經濟的，浪費的

example: They closed the factory, saying it was uneconomic.
他們關閉了工廠，說它不賺錢。
The price of oil dropped so low that it become uneconomic to drill.
石油價格跌到如此之低，開採變得不賺錢了。
A large room sometimes represents an uneconomic use of space.
房間大有時候說明空間利用不經濟。
Synonym
wasteful

NONE: › unpleasant and causing people to feel no respect
令人不快的；丟臉的

example: We were treated to the unedifying spectacle of Congressmen fighting like children.
我們目睹了議員像孩子們一樣打架的丟臉場景。

NONE: › having received little or no education
未受教育的；缺乏教育的
› not having been voted into a particular important job or position
沒有當選的，落選的
B1 not having a job that provides money
失業的；待業的
C1 people who do not have a job that provides money
失業人員；待業人員

example: He's been unemployed for over a year.
他失業一年多了。
There are now over four million unemployed in this country.
目前該國有400多萬失業人口。
Our department provides services for the unemployed.
我們的部門為失業人員提供服務。

NONE: B1 the number of people who do not have a job that provides money
失業人數；失業率
› the state of being unemployed
失業（狀態）
› US →
unemployment benefit

example: Unemployment has fallen/risen again for the third consecutive month.
失業人數連續第三個月上升／下降。
失業救濟金，失業津貼（同 unemployment benefit）

More examplesOver half his speech was devoted to the issue of unemployment.The problems of poverty, homelessness and unemployment are all interconnected.We are firmly committed to reducing unemployment.long-term unemploymentThese decisions have had to be taken against a background of high unemployment.

NONE: › money that the government pays to unemployed people who are looking for a job
失業救濟金，失業津貼

example: Compare
jobseeker's allowance

NONE: › without something making it difficult for you to do something
不受妨礙的，沒有阻礙的

example: People can decide how to care for their children, unencumbered by interference from the state.
人們可以不受政府干涉地決定如何照顧自己的孩子。

NONE: › used to describe activities or events, especially unpleasant ones, when they seem to continue for ever
（尤指令人不快的活動或事件）無休止的，沒完沒了的

example: Motherhood seemed to her an unending cycle of cooking, washing, and cleaning.
做母親對她來講似乎就是整天沒完沒了的做飯、洗衣和打掃清潔。

NONE: › If a situation or experience is unendurable, it is so unpleasant or painful that it is almost impossible to bear.
無法忍受的，難以容忍的
› If a rule or law is unenforceable, it is impossible to force people to obey it.
（規則或法律）無約束力的，無強制力的
› not showing understanding or knowledge; not enlightened
落後的；無知的；未經啟蒙的
› An unenviable duty or necessary action is unpleasant or difficult.
不值得羡慕的；令人不快的；困難的

example: I had the unenviable task of cleaning up after the party.
派對結束後，我要做那討厭的清理工作。

NONE: › formal different in size, level, amount, etc.
（尺寸、水準、數量等）不相等的，不同的
› not treating everyone the same; unfair
不公平的，不平等的
› to not have the necessary ability, power, or qualities to achieve something
對…不能勝任；對…力所不及

example: The slices were unequal in size.
這兩片大小明顯不一樣。
Until women are paid as much as men, they will be competing on unequal terms.
在男女同工同酬前，婦女將會一直在不平等的條件下與男人競爭。
They have an unequal relationship.
他們之間的關係相當不平等。
He tried to cheer her up but found himself unequal to the task.
他想讓她高興起來，但發現他根本無法做到。

NONE: › better or more extreme than any other
無雙的；出類拔萃的

example: Though small, this restaurant offers a range of fish dishes unequalled anywhere else in London.
這家餐廳儘管很小，但它做的一系列魚類菜餚肴卻是倫敦其他餐廳都比不了的。

NONE: › total, or expressed in a clear and certain way
完全的；表達明確的；毫不含糊的

example: The prime minister, he said, had the party's unequivocal support.
他說首相得到了全黨堅定不移的支援。
The church has been unequivocal in its condemnation of the violence.
教會明確譴責該暴力事件。

NONE: › never failing to hit a target
萬無一失的，百發百中的
› always accurate in your judgment or ability
永不犯錯的；一貫正確的

example: He has an unerring talent for writing catchy melodies.
他總是可以寫出旋律動人的美妙樂曲。

NONE: › abbreviation for United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organization: a department of the United Nations that aims to encourage peace between countries through education, science, and culture
聯合國教科文組織（United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organization的縮寫）
C2 not ethical (= based on moral beliefs)
不道德的，不合乎道德標準的
C2 not level, equal, flat, or continuous
不平整的；參差不齊的；不平等的；不平坦的；不連續的
› different in quality; often used to avoid saying bad
（品質）不穩定的，時好時壞的

example: Be careful on that path - the paving stones are uneven.
走那條路時要小心——鋪路石很不平。
There is an uneven distribution of wealth across the country from the north to the south.
全國的財富分配南北很不均衡。
The contest was very uneven - the other team was much stronger than us.
比賽很不平等——對方參賽隊的實力比我們強很多。
Your work has been a little uneven this term, Matthew.
馬修，你的功課這學期很不穩定。

NONE: › two horizontal bars of different height that are used in an event in women's gymnastics, or the event itself
高低杠（女子體操項目）
C2 An uneventful time or situation is one in which nothing interesting or surprising happens.
平淡無奇的；平靜的

example: It was an uneventful journey.
這是一次平淡無奇的旅程。

NONE: › not bad; having nothing that anyone could criticize or disapprove of
不錯的；無懈可擊的，無可指責的

example: an unexceptionable speech
一場無懈可擊的演講

NONE: › ordinary, not exceptional
平常的，普通的

example: He was a hard-working, if unexceptional, student.
他是一個資質一般但非常用功的學生。

NONE: B1 not expected
出乎意料的，想不到的

example: Her resignation was completely unexpected.
她的辭職完全是個意外。
How lovely to see you here - this really is an unexpected pleasure!
在這裡見到你真好，實在是沒想到！

NONE: › Unexplained events, behaviour, etc. are ones for which people do not know or understand the reason.
（事件、行爲等）未說明的，未解釋的，原因不詳的

example: an unexplained death/noise
原因不明的死亡／噪音
He was shot dead earlier this year in unexplained circumstances.
他在今年早些時候莫名其妙地被人開槍打死了。

NONE: › bleeding from the digestive system for which the cause is not known
不明原因的消化道出血
› An unexplored place is one where people have not been to find out what is there.
無人涉足的；未經勘察的
› An unexplored plan, idea, or subject is one that has not been examined to find out what it involves.
（計劃、想法或主題）未經研究的

example: The subject of alternative medical care for older people has been entirely unexplored.
尚未有人就替代性老年人醫療保健這一問題做徹底研究。

NONE: › An unexpurgated book, article, film, etc. is complete and contains everything, including parts considered likely to cause offence.
（書籍、文章、電影等）未經刪節的，完整的
